channel.title: Awards on Aarush Mane
channel.description: Recent content in Awards on Aarush Mane

item.title: HackHarvard Undergraduate Hackathon | Nemo
item.description: 3rd Overall Best Project and 2nd, ASUS Save the Earth Sustainability Track for Nemo. Conceived the Grok-assisted physics workflow, built validation checks, and pitched to judges and sponsors.

item.title: 2024 AIME Qualifier
item.description: Qualified for the American Invitational Mathematics Examination through strong performance on the AMC competition series.

item.title: FIRST World Championship Division Winner
item.description: Won the Curie Division at the 2024 FIRST World Championship with Kronos after a season of autonomous, vision, and match-strategy work.

item.title: Innovation in Control Award
item.description: Won the FIRST Innovation in Control Award at the 2026 FMA Robbinsville District Event for an Oculus Quest navigation system, a cloud debugging chatbot, and scouting analytics that linked robot performance to match strategy.

item.title: National Merit Scholarship Winner
item.description: Named a National Merit Scholarship winner for academic achievement and PSAT/NMSQT performance.
